metadata.description: EXPLICIT-COLUMN schema variant for the Sentinel Destination template. Use this ONLY if your Abstract routing/mapper emits explicit per-field ACS columns instead of the default wrapped-dynamic 'AbstractEvent' object. The DCR drops any column not declared here, so the stream/table columns MUST match your mapper output. This is a STARTER set built from the ACS fields the ASim_AbstractEvent parser references; expand it to the full set from Abstract's all_fields.json (docs.abstractsecurity.app -> Integrations -> Destination -> Azure Sentinel Destination). Deploy: az deployment group create -g <rg> --template-file templates/destinations/sentinel-destination.azuredeploy.json --parameters @parameters/sentinel-destination.full-schema.parameters.json --parameters principalId=<sp-object-id>. TimeGenerated (datetime) is REQUIRED by Log Analytics. 'AbstractEvent' (dynamic) is retained as a raw catch-all so nothing is lost.
metadata.note: Nested ACS fields (e.g. user.target.name) cannot be flat columns; keep them inside the AbstractEvent dynamic column or flatten them in your mapper to a flat column name here.
